source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade and Downgrade FPGA firmware by Web when system is booted
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade FPGA firmware through web UI
(Need to do AC cycle after flash complete).

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + FPGA image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- FPGA upgrade/downgrade via the BMC web UI: the agent first places the exact user-provided FPGA image where the web-UIs upload control expects it, then drives the FPGA flash page (upload image, start update, wait for completion) with the SUT must be booted and the BMC web-UI reachable; an AC cycle is required after flash completes; after completion verify the FPGA version. Interactive web-UI upload is not a single sshpass one-liner; walk the UI steps after the image is in place.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return screenshots + the flash-completion status and the FPGA version shown before/after so the user confirms a successful flash and a clean single reset.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: FPGA firmware flash via web UI is state-changing and can brick the BMC/host if interrupted; AC cycle after flash is mandatory; flash only the user-specified image and do not interrupt mid-flash.

original_test_intent: Perform approved FPGA firmware upgrade and downgrade through the BMC WebUI while the host is booted, then apply the source-required AC cycle and verify active FPGA version plus platform health.
original_method: A human selects/uploads/commits each approved FPGA image and observes WebUI progress; after completion the approved project AC-cycle method is executed once and independent interfaces verify activation, POST/OS/BMC/SEL and component health.
manual_activity: The destructive WebUI operation is manual core work; the AC cycle follows an approved project method and may require operator power handling. Agent support is evidence and monitoring only.
required_inputs: FPGA component/current/upgrade/downgrade versions and image hashes
AC-cycle method, controller, off/on timing and count
safety_requirements: One approved image/transition and one unchanged AC-cycle plan at a time; no automatic retry or repeated cycle.
Do not generalize Seq 182: this source says AC cycle but does not mandate physical cable removal; use the engineer-approved project method.
Verify image/component compatibility and preserve WebUI/power failures.
Stop on uncertain flash state, power restoration, version or BMC/host health.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare image/compatibility evidence, monitor logs/power telemetry under the approved plan and collect independent pre/post FPGA/BMC/host/SEL data.
Do not operate or claim completion of the WebUI core or formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform the WebUI update and the exact AC-cycle method/hand-off.
Assess activation/health and issue separate upgrade/downgrade verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The attended workflow and mandatory AC cycle fit, but browser automation cannot replace manual WebUI acceptance and the clean-single-reset phrase is not a source requirement.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor WebUI manually and the approved AC-cycle mechanism; use the existing read-only version script and health collection afterward.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The booted-host, WebUI, required AC cycle, script and 5/30-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED FPGA WEB UPDATE WITH CONTROLLED AC ACTIVATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the manual update to an immutable image, capture WebUI completion, execute one approved AC-cycle plan and verify the active FPGA component/version and complete platform health independently.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMC/FPGA combinations supporting the vendor WebUI update and AC activation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/WebUI/browser, FPGA image/component and power-controller versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor FPGA WebUI update/activation/recovery documentation and project power SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds component identity, power contract, activation evidence and recovery gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Distinguishes uploaded/staged firmware from active post-AC FPGA firmware and catches host/BMC regressions.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Power mechanism is project-specific; do not infer physical cable removal or extra reset from unrelated cases/overlays.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define FPGA images and AC-cycle mechanism/timing. Completion applies only to that named plan and cannot claim other components, version pairs or power methods.
expected_evidence: Manual WebUI transcript and completion state
Post-cycle active version and platform health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source clearly requires a WebUI flash followed by an AC cycle; exact project versions, power method and criteria are readiness inputs, and the historical single-reset wording is rejected.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Missing project plan details do not create permanent BLOCKED under V3.1. Manual WebUI core makes the case MANUAL ONLY once approved inputs exist.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps its AC-cycle scope but rejects browser substitution and invented reset semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves high-risk power/recovery controls while changing BLOCKED to MANUAL ONLY under the project-input rule.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Applies Seq 182 only to its case and does not convert generic AC cycle into mandatory physical cable removal.

review_improvement: Separates flash staging from post-AC activation and prevents missing project parameters from being misclassified as an irreducible block.
independent_technical_reasoning: The update/activation lifecycle is understandable and project-specific details can be approved without redefining the library; because the write is driven and observed through WebUI, the core remains manual.
